settings.title: One API, every
settings.intro: Whether it's a one-time charge, a recurring subscription, or a marketplace split-pay, RelayPay gives you the primitives to build on — and the docs to do it fast.

design.title: One-time charges
design.text: Collect card, wallet, and bank payments with a single POST. Built-in 3-D Secure, AVS, and fraud scoring on every authorization.

design.title: Checkout hosted + embedded
design.text: Launch a hosted checkout page in ten minutes, or embed our rendered fields with a few lines of JS. PCI scope stays on us.

build.title: Recurring billing
build.text: Create, pause, and upgrade subscriptions with prorations handled automatically. Dunning and smart retries recover the revenue you'd otherwise lose.

build.title: Usage & metered billing
build.text: Bill by seat, API call, or a custom event stream. Our metering engine keeps tallies accurate even at high volume.

launch.title: Instant payouts
launch.text: Send money to your sellers, creators, or contractors with fast settlement via bank transfer, instant card payout, or local rails.

launch.title: Split & marketplace payments
launch.text: Route each transaction to multiple destinations with configurable fees. Platform payout logic handled for you.

settings.title: From signup to live in
settings.intro: We removed the procurement drag and the certification slog. Most teams process their first real transaction the same day they create an account.

steps.title: Create your account
steps.text: Sign up and get sandbox keys instantly. No sales call, no underwriting delay — approve your details in minutes.

steps.title: Test in sandbox
steps.text: Use our test cards and webhook simulator to build and verify your flows against a fully functional sandbox with no money at risk.

steps.title: Go live
steps.text: Flip the switch with your production keys. Our SDKs and drop-in elements mean most teams cut the ribbon in under a week.

steps.title: Grow with payouts
steps.text: Turn on subscriptions, split payments, or instant payouts as your product matures. The same API scales with you.

settings.note: Typical teams are processing real transactions within 5 business days of their first signup — we get you past the boring parts fast.

settings.title: The gateway your
settings.intro: Payments should be your product's enabling layer, not its bottleneck. Here's what makes RelayPay different from the incumbent rails.

features.title: Developer-first DX
features.text: Idempotent requests, typed SDKs, first-class webhooks, and a Postman collection out of the box. Our docs read like a design spec, not an apology.

features.title: Fraud built in
features.text: Machine-learned risk scoring on every transaction with customizable rules. Block the chargebacks before they reach your inbox.

features.title: Global by default
features.text: Accept 180+ currencies with automatic DCC and local payment methods — we handle FX, routing, and compliance on your behalf.

features.title: Active-active uptime
features.text: Our gateway runs across redundant regions with automatic failover. When a region sleeps, your traffic keeps flowing.

features.title: Transparent pricing
features.text: Flat interchange-plus pricing with no monthly minimums, no hidden gateway fees, and no surprise line items on your statement.

features.title: Instant, programmatic backoffice
features.text: Refunds, disputes, payouts, and reconciliation are all API-first. Your finance team gets clean exports without CSV archaeology.

settings.title: Questions teams
settings.intro: Straight answers about fees, security, and what moving to RelayPay actually takes.

items.question: How does RelayPay's pricing compare to the big gateways?
items.answer: We use transparent interchange-plus pricing with no monthly fee and no setup charge. Our goal is to be cheaper than the legacy providers once you factor in their hidden gateway, monthly, and per-transaction add-ons.

items.question: Is my card data secure and PCI compliant?
items.answer: Yes. RelayPay is a PCI DSS Level 1 service provider. With our hosted and embedded checkout, card data never touches your servers, which keeps your PCI scope minimal.

items.question: How long does it really take to integrate?
items.answer: Most teams process their first live transaction within a week. Our SDKs, drop-in elements, and Postman collection cover the common flows, and the docs walk you through edge cases.

items.question: Do you support subscriptions and recurring billing?
items.answer: Absolutely. Create, pause, upgrade, and cancel subscriptions with automatic prorations, dunning, and smart retries to recover failed payments.

items.question: Can I migrate from my current provider?
items.answer: Yes. We provide one-click card-holder migration, a webhook mapping guide, and a dedicated migration runbook. Our team will hold your hand through the cutover.
